mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_run (run_id, conversation_id, workspace_id, initiator_user_id, status, instruction, resource_scope, allowed_tools, version, created_at, started_at, finished_at, failure_code, failure_message, lifecycle_sequence) VALUES (#{runId}, #{conversationId}, #{workspaceId}, #{initiatorUserId}, #{status}, #{instruction}, CAST(#{resourceScope} AS JSON), CAST(#{allowedTools} AS JSON), #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{failureCode}, #{failureMessage}, #{lifecycleSequence})
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, conversation_id, workspace_id, initiator_user_id, status, instruction, CAST(resource_scope AS CHAR) resource_scope, CAST(allowed_tools AS CHAR) allowed_tools, version, created_at, started_at, finished_at, failure_code, failure_message, lifecycle_sequence FROM agent_run WHERE run_id = #{runId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, run_id, conversation_id, workspace_id, initiator_user_id, status, instruction, CAST(resource_scope AS CHAR) resource_scope, CAST(allowed_tools AS CHAR) allowed_tools, version, created_at, started_at, finished_at, failure_code, failure_message, lifecycle_sequence FROM agent_run WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status IN (0, 1, 2, 3) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, run_id, conversation_id, workspace_id, initiator_user_id, status, instruction, CAST(resource_scope AS CHAR) resource_scope, CAST(allowed_tools AS CHAR) allowed_tools, version, created_at, started_at, finished_at, failure_code, failure_message, lifecycle_sequence FROM agent_run WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET status = 5, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, finished_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO agent_run_lifecycle_event(event_id, run_id, sequence, event_type) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{runId}, #{sequence}, #{eventType})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET status = #{status}, lifecycle_sequence = #{sequence}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, started_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 1 AND started_at IS NULL THEN NOW() ELSE started_at END, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND lifecycle_sequence < #{sequence} AND status IN (0, 1, 2, 3)
